caption: The drawing features a single, vertically positioned bottle in the center of the composition. The bottle has a narrow neck and a wider body, tapering down again toward the base. The surface of the bottle is decorated with marbled, swirling patterns in shades of red, pink, white, green, and some muted blue, creating a layered effect that follows the contours of the bottle. The background is a plain, light beige color with subtle variations, but it does not contain any additional objects or details. The overall composition is minimal, with the detailed bottle standing out prominently against the empty background.
